sections.body:
WhatsApp Business: Conversational service & commerce.

Omnichannel: Connected journeys, every channel.

Connect the channels your customers use with the teams, applications and workflows behind each interaction. Shape service and commerce journeys that keep context as people move between digital conversations and human support.

sections.heading: Design the whole journey, not just a single channel

cards.title: Conversation design
cards.description: Map customer intent, useful responses and the steps needed to complete a service or commerce journey.

cards.title: Service workflows
cards.description: Shape clear routes for enquiries, updates and service requests, including handover to a person when needed.

cards.title: Connected commerce
cards.description: Bring product enquiries and purchasing conversations into the wider customer journey.

cards.title: Channel continuity
cards.description: Define how context moves between WhatsApp, web, mobile and service teams so customers do not have to start again.

cards.title: Workflow automation
cards.description: Use automation to route requests and move information between conversations and business applications.

cards.title: Journey assurance
cards.description: Test conversations, integrations and handovers before release, then refine the experience as needs change.

sections.heading: From customer need to a connected journey

items.description: Discover the service and commerce moments that matter to customers and the teams supporting them.
Design conversations, channel transitions and human handovers around those needs.
Connect business systems and workflows, with clear responsibilities for customer data and access.
Test end-to-end journeys, launch in stages and use feedback to improve the experience.
